narr: A warm front lifting north across South Florida along with east winds from the Atlantic provided support for rounds of heavy showers across SE Florida.
ev: Reports from emergency managers and broadcast media of significant flooding in Miami Shores, Biscayne Park, and North Miami. Water entered the garage of a home in Miami Shores, and several reports of significant street flooding leading to stalled vehicles across these areas. Rainfall amounts of 4 to 6 inches were received from the area.
